newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers firm on overnight cargo gains.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers firm on overnight cargo gains.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Thursday were quoted firmer, tracking the overnight gains in the cargo market, traders said.

Sellers who were squeezed by the sudden jumped in cargo prices late Wednesday, have raised their offers in an attempt to over their losses. But most shipowners were at stand off, citing the high prices.

Both majors and independents were quoting 180-cst prices at between $128-129 tonne and bunker 380-cst prices at between $123-$124. MDO and gasoil were steady at $222-$226 and $235-$240 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
